candidates.documented_support: Only the last instruction explicitly requiring only documented information and an established reason/indication triggers MET-only selection for options having an applicable rule path. Options without any applicable rule path retain their valid original selection; invalid initial plus uncovered option falls back. Other questions use frozen assembler.
candidates.covered_support: Across eligible questions, require MET for an option with applicable rule paths, but preserve valid original selections having no applicable path. Invalid initial answer with an uncovered option falls back. Diagnostic policy only.
